calls.title: Joel & James
calls.summary: Joel Rosenbaum has extensive experience in security sales, with a 15-year trajectory focused on two-factor authentication and risk-based security, holding roles in both startups and large organizations like Microsoft. Currently at BlueVoyant, he leads business development in Germany, emphasizing pipeline building and contract management. GrowthBook, expanding rapidly in Europe with a focus on enterprise deals, has a strong product-market fit with technical buyers, particularly in Germany and surrounding countries. The sales role discussed involves closing deals across various European territories, emphasizes consultative selling, and requires quick technical knowledge ramp-up, which aligns well with Joel's consultative sales style and technical expertise.
calls.keywords: Germany, sales, security, GrowthBook, enterprise deals, data ownership
